title: Focus the reply input when opening a thread
summary: The exact root ask is implemented and integrated: clicking Reply opens the desktop thread pane with ChannelComposer autoFocus enabled. Commit acd7410 is an ancestor of origin/main. Broader issues raised in follow-ups were only partly delivered: mobile Threads rows/header (5c9381e) and fullscreen thread composer/@ menu (0fb1ce9) are also ancestors of origin/main; the mobile composer change lacked phone verification in the replies. The later owner request to fix and merge all was not fully closed out. Unread-thread reply width and @ menu, replying-indicator alignment, and the undefined .some crash lack completion evidence; crash needs server log/repro. No relevant active UI task was found; related project task buddy_project_a978f8e4-6566-434d-aa9d-2667269da30e is in review but its acceptance criteria concern Buddy DMs in Channels, not thread focus. These asks remain untracked or need owner/Product Development Lead to route into existing ownership.
nextAction: Product Development Lead should route the remaining UI checks to Buddies UI Engineer; verify the mobile thread composer/@ menu and unread-thread width on phone, confirm replying-indicator alignment, and obtain the server log or exact Wave_sim CEO repro for the .some crash before assigning a fix. Update/reuse an appropriate task for the unresolved items.
